notes: All 187 pieces of the inventory appear exactly once (b1-b187). Ids b185-b187 (88930 curved brick, cab doors 3822/3821) were appended because their exact step was unclear.
Minifigures (heads, hair, torsos, legs) are not in the parts list, so they are not modelled.
The manual has no per-step parts boxes for the chassis steps 1-27. Piece-to-step assignment was inferred from the pictures and the inventory counts, so some joins are approximate.
The positions of the cab doors (3821/3822) and curved brick 88930 are not clearly shown. They are attached to plausible neighbouring bricks.
Wheels use 4488 axle-hole to 6014b pin-hole (revolute). The tyres are pushed onto the wheels.
Stickers are modelled as one sheet node (b184) with stick edges to the parts that carry stickers.
The roof hatch (b108) uses its pins to snap into the red clips b100/b101. The rear door's red handles clip into the black 92280 clips.
The stretcher is loaded into the ambulance in step 46 and only rests on the rear floor, so it is a contact edge.

The disconnected groups are NOT an error. Pages 2-5 and 60-63 show that this set builds several separate models: (1) the ambulance, (2) the street corner with traffic light, hydrant and bin, (3) the bicycle, (4) the stretcher, and (5) two paramedic first-aid cases (green handle + tile). The cases are held by minifigures, and the manual never joins any of these to each other or to the vehicle. No physical connection exists between them, so none was invented.
